review_method: After the first-reader JSON was committed, a separate failure-oriented rereading of the pinned 1190x1764 original printed JPEG was conducted within the SAME ChatGPT conversation/context. This challenge audit is logically distinct from constructing the first-pass text, but is NOT a separate blind reader or independent third agent. Historical letterforms remain unresolved. No embedded/original OCR, online text or parallel edition was consulted.
